import sys, time, random; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')

    d=truth[b]-truth[a]

prof={'groups':K,'jitter_ps':[rng.randint(0,100) for _ in range(K)],'measurements':meas}
t0=time.time(); cal=para.Calibration(prof); t1=time.time()
